brief:
Israeli and Greek naval forces are conducting a joint exercise carrying political messages to Turkey, according to Army Radio. The drill includes training to counter maritime threats, joint sailing operations, and missile strikes against hostile vessels.

The exercise reflects deepening military cooperation between Israel and Greece in the eastern Mediterranean, a region where Turkey has asserted competing maritime claims and energy interests.

title: Israeli and Greek navies conduct joint drill signaling Turkey
